limits: Adapted fixed-cost ASSAO kernel, not the complete Godot Forward+ implementation.
Final-surface compositing affects already-lit color; no separate ambient light term.
Screen effects that invalidate geometric depth are preserved, not occluded.
Eight short checkpoint windows, not whole-game visual certification.
GPU timings include instrumentation; not a production FPS benchmark.

Whole final RAM is identical in seven scenes; the intro differs in 15 bytes, with equal endpoint gameplay fields, game-tick counts and all sampled native/atlas images. This is not a whole-RAM determinism claim.
